_meta.note: 12 clubs have full squads; the other 24 carry verified key players only (partial:true). Ratings: well-known players are set explicitly, players already in the Premier League database reuse that rating, everyone else is estimated from club strength and flagged est:1.

mergeInstructions: 2. Merge this file's SQUADS into base.SQUADS. No keys collide.
3. Merge PXDOB into base.PXDOB, keeping any existing entry.
4. Keep CLUBS as a separate lookup for pot, coefficient, odds, tier and qualification route.
5. Players carrying est:1 have an estimated rating. Correct those first if ratings matter.

schema.SQUADS: key is "Club|2026", same format as the Premier League database
schema.player: n name, nat nationality, pos array of GK/DEF/MID/ATT, rtg, prime, est:1 if estimated, note if a same-name clash was resolved manually
schema.CLUBS: country, pot, coeff (UEFA five-year rank), route, odds (decimal), tier (derived strength), partial
